title: Cyborg between worlds — working concept
hook: A first-person cyborg discovers its dreams reveal real worlds, reshapes one modular weapon/shield with their technology and magic, and chooses which abilities to carry into the next destination.
audience: Players seeking skilled aimed combat, transformative equipment, build discovery, exploration, meaningful achievements and varied expeditions.
core_loop: Explore a procedurally varied world, fight using freely chosen attacks and defense, earn ability-changing attachments, choose or discover synergies, defeat a guardian, preserve learned patterns and campaign milestones, and select active powers for a crossing.
score_notes: Provisional indirect estimates, not market evidence. Klaus rejected beta2 and found the subsequent studies lacking in combat feedback and art B. The folding correction passes technical checks; ordinary enjoyment and a repeatable high-quality art pipeline remain unproved.

evidence.claim: Developer listing describes movement/aiming, class upgrades, weapon variety, mixed authored/random environments and persistent Basecamp unlocks; an inspiration, not validation of our concept.
Developer listing describes hero abilities, weapon drops and varied stages as part of build-based FPS runs; our charge-allocation design is an untested proposal.
Developer describes FPS combat, boss cores, build enhancers and tower reward/trap manipulation; a close originality challenge for our proposals, not sales evidence.

risks: One safe attack/guard or automatic-effect routine could remain optimal across different worlds and attachment names.
First-person transforming equipment, enemy animation/navigation and disparate world art need substantial integration and coherent readability.
Carryover can either invalidate destination challenges or make earned rewards feel confiscated; permanent ownership and active transfer must be clearly separated.
Procedural combinations, reaction chains, story persistence and interrupted reward/transition saves require actual testing.
next_test: Assess the0.3.1 folding shield, full-charge payoff and useful melee. Establish a guided creation pipeline across distinct procedural biomes: first proposed Rodin/Blender asset trial must be inspected as actual Unreal geometry. A ruins kit is not the selected solution. Resume games/dreambound/STATUS.md.
decision_reason: Klaus parks the FPS/cyborg-worlds experiment on 2026-09-11: workload and time do not fit his full-time job and other projects. Preserve the existing game and design; research few-day commercial games with a NOK 20,000+ lifetime cash-profit target. No replacement selected.
engine_direction: Unreal 5.8.2; first person, chosen by the owner
scope_note: Substantially greater ambition; no literal 10x multiplier, feature quota or hard development/owner-time cap. Several distinct worlds are the campaign direction; counts, transfer allowance and final length remain in refinement.

prototype_envelope.scope: Proposed: a short escape/discovery, one substantial procedurally varied realm with meaningful attachment progression and a boss, plus compact playable arrival elsewhere to test carrying an earned ability. This is not two complete biomes or a finished campaign.

commercial_hypothesis: Unassessed in this inspiration pass; no price, sales forecast or acquisition expenditure selected.
title_note: Descriptive internal research label; naming/originality clearance not performed.

procedural_generation.direction: Designed 3D encounter modules with generated routes, compatible room configurations, encounters, objectives and rewards under playability and pacing constraints.
procedural_generation.next_test_refinement: Replay multiple generated versions of the representative biome; compare tactics, build choices, fairness and replay interest. Verify seed reproduction, save/resume, dependencies and actual in-engine traversal.
procedural_generation.evidence: 0.3.0-segments1 assembles three physically connected courts with seeded route direction/turn and cover variants. Staged engine checks cover seed reproduction, alternate layout signatures, capsule sweeps and connector floor probes; progression uses explicit room activation. Ordinary varied-run enjoyment and full multi-biome generation remain unverified.

owner_selected_foundations.equipment: First-person modular shield made of individual pieces. Holding LMB lights pieces sequentially; release launches exactly the lit pieces and retains the rest for defense. Spent blocking pieces and projectiles destroyed by certain enemies each begin independent timed regeneration. Surviving deployed pieces recall and visibly reattach. Freely chosen close offense/guard and creative upgrades remain; no mandatory all-at-once loop. Count, timings and detailed bindings remain proposals.
owner_selected_foundations.equipment_growth: The weapon/shield is the central evolving object. Explore extensive technology, magic, crystals, jewelry, stackable enhancements and behavioral evolution; final counts, sockets and rank rules are not selected.
owner_selected_foundations.story_seed: A cyborg's apparent dreams reveal real reachable worlds with different technology, magic and biomes
owner_selected_foundations.power_and_rewards: Owner explicitly wants a large combinable mod/magic catalog and genuinely overpowered builds earned through creativity, difficult acquisition and smart combinations. Boss, elite and rare loot should introduce fresh abilities worth trying; preserve powerful payoffs and earned ownership.
owner_selected_foundations.art_style: B — sculpted painterly 3D: substantial modeled shapes, tactile materials, broad painted color transitions and expressive lighting across fantasy and technology; exact Unreal fidelity unproven
owner_selected_foundations.open_design: Exact antagonist identities/motives and reasons for fighting (explicitly deferred), wider lore, weapon self-awareness, revised control/timing and attachment rules, transfer rules and campaign scope. Existing story sketches remain proposals.

identifier_note: The reactor-raider id is preserved from the initial comparison; the working concept has evolved through explicit owner steering.

art_workflow.authority: Owner delegated workflow choice and reported Blender installed and Fusion 360 available
art_workflow.direction: Owner requires repeatable high-quality asset creation across procedural biomes and rejects a ruins kit as the general solution. Recommended trial: guided Rodin Gen-2.5 source mesh, Blender finishing/materials and actual Unreal inspection before expanding to another biome. No tool quality winner is established.
art_workflow.evidence: Folding shield, new original garden geometry and rendered0.3.1 combat capture exist; environment/enemy detail still falls substantially below B. Official Rodin/Tripo/Meshy capabilities were researched. Rodin Start Creating leads to login; no account, AI model, subscription or purchase was acquired.
art_workflow.style_review: B remains owner-selected. Klaus rejected beta2 as nowhere near the anchor. Future fidelity claims require actual moving Unreal gameplay with the intended weapon, enemy, authored scene and sound.

attachment_design.status: Original unimplemented proposals; some concepts overlap and may merge. Ranks are not separate abilities. This is neither a validated ability count nor a release-scope commitment.

decision_history.reason: Recommended research direction for owner fit; no game selected, no market/price validation and no human test of this concept.

Owner selected first person and a combined modular weapon/shield, then proposed a cyborg discovering and visiting real worlds from its dreams. Integrated writer, art and producer proposals; preserve unresolved lore and carryover rules without claiming implementation.

Owner endorsed the basic direction and explicitly requested broad creative combinations, earned OP builds and fresh boss/elite/rare abilities. Revised overly restrictive effect rules and identified an earned power-spike test; implementation and fun remain unverified.

Klaus endorsed style B with 'B looks great' after reviewing generated comparisons and discussing feasibility. Adopt sculpted painterly 3D as the art direction; exact weapon/world design and actual in-engine fidelity remain unproven.

Owner rejected beta2 and clarified physical shield offense/recall with real attack-defense commitment. Preserve the broader selected game while replacing the failed combat/art approach. Antagonist and conflict development is explicitly deferred.
